navIcons.note: Unchanged: 24-box round-join craft nav, bbox/overflow gate D/T/M.

typeSystems.note: Unchanged: six display faces, device-aware chrome.

imagery.note: Coat keeps V-opening, lapels, buttons, pockets on a dress form. Dress gains hip and a flared hem instead of a tube. Trousers hang from a hanger with seat, drape folds, belt loops and a real leg gap — not two bars. Ricciola/gambero/ostrica/tonno stay four platings. Olivo is a terraced grove with silver canopy masses, not a lollipop tree. Contact sheet has film rebate frames. Still procedural SVG, not photography.

semanticDiversity.note: Look/ticket/plate titles still map 1:1 onto data-garment/data-dish/data-scene. Olivo requires grove+terrace and rejects the 5c3e976 canopy path. Trousers require seat+drape. Canvas fingerprints still fail reused compositions. Title must sit below the sil, not overlay the garment.

emptySpaceHierarchy.note: Fashion subjects scaled to 0.9 so hem and stand survive slice on M/T. Look titles padded below the sil.

interaction.note: in prova / data-state=on kept. Hover/pressed/loading/empty/success gates kept D/T/M.
